title: Gradio analytics are on
explanation: Gradio sends usage analytics to https://api.gradio.app and checks for a newer version there, unless GRADIO_ANALYTICS_ENABLED is set to something other than "True" or the app passes analytics_enabled=False. When the variable is unset analytics are on. Upstream compares case-sensitively against "True", while this rule treats any casing of "true" as on.

evidence.detail: gradio 5.4.0 installed; not disabled in the image (none of GRADIO_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=!true)

fix: Set GRADIO_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=False in the image environment (and analytics_enabled=False in code).
